LanguageData.Phinix_theme_unusedTip: These keys are not currently registered or their value type is unsupported. File values and user overrides are retained.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_selectItem: Select a color or parameter to edit. Switching themes keeps drafts; canceling discards unapplied changes.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_itemUnavailable: This item is not registered now. Its draft and input are retained; you can clear its user override.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_clearTip: Clear your change and use the theme file value.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_restoreTip: Ignore this value in the theme file and use the inherited or default value. Apply to save.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_openFolderFailed: Could not launch the file manager. Copy the path to locate the exported file.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_exportPackageTip: Exports a ZIP for local installation in the store. Reuse your package ID and change its version for updates. Existing files are preserved. This does not upload or publish.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_noItems: No matches. Try background, text, or a plugin name.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_browseHelp: Choose an area, then adjust its color on the right. ★ marks beginner essentials. Search includes all settings.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_colorHelp: Drag the sliders or enter values from 0 to 1. Check the color samples below; the actual interface changes after Apply and save.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_invalidHex: Enter 6 or 8 hexadecimal digits, such as #336699. The optional last two digits set opacity.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_colorPickerHelp: Choose on the wheel or a preset, then adjust brightness and opacity. The interface changes after Apply and save.
LanguageData.Phinix_theme_colorAdvancedHelp: The picker, hex and RGB edit the same draft. RGB channels range from 0 to 1. Six hex digits keep the current opacity; eight include opacity. Apply to save.
